reason: B is more physically credible because Al can stabilize coherent L1₂ Ni3(Al,Ti)-type γ′ in an FCC Ni-rich matrix, whereas A assumes coherent “Ni3Ti-like γ′” without specifying an Al-bearing composition and risks forming non-L1₂, brittle Ni–Ti intermetallics. B remains imperfect—its composition and aging window are overly broad and it closely extends prior γ/γ′ work—but it provides the sounder testable extension to Ti- and Ni-primary chemistry.
